extraction: Anthropic when to use multi-agent: (1) Task decomposes into independent subtasks (our 18 langs). (2) Subtasks need different expertise (Engine=build, Verdict=verify, Miss=apply). (3) Quality requires independent review (Verdict independent of Engine). (4) Parallel execution beneficial (staggered engines). ALL FOUR TRUE for our campaign. Single agent would: lose specialization, no independent review, sequential bottleneck. Multi-agent is correct architecture.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: confirms 3-agent model is correct per Anthropic criteria, not over-engineering
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
